entries.closure_note: Collapsed the redundant ternary in the settings-workspace-section test mock pickDirectory.
Accepted: the seven locked copy constants are intentionally mirrored in the Studio fixture and the App section; centralizing them would cross import boundaries for small, spec-locked strings.
Updated the Settings shell helper copy to mention workspace in both en and zh-CN catalogs, and updated the Studio fixture SHELL_HELPER constant.
Already-fixed: handleChangeFolder sets saved=false at the start of every gesture, so the saved honesty banner clears on cancel or error.
Load failure now falls back to DEFAULT_WORKSPACE in the catch block so the picker receives a non-empty defaultPath.
Change Folder button is now disabled when path is empty or while loading, preventing an empty defaultPath.
Wrapped handleChangeFolder in useCallback so it is not recreated on every render.
